text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Myocardial Infarction secondary to Typhoid Endocarditis. The combination of your classic angina symptoms, confirmed typhoid infection, and new-onset ischemia on ECG strongly suggests an infected heart valve (endocarditis) causing coronary embolization or severe vasculitis. This is a life-threatening emergency requiring immediate admission for IV antibiotics and potential cardiac surgery.
